## Agents


## Services
- [Catalog Products - catalog.catalog-management.catalog-products - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/services/catalog.catalog-management.catalog-products/0.0.1.mdx) - Manages product catalog definitions, release metadata, and publication lifecycle- [Catalog Inventory - catalog.inventory-management.catalog-inventory - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/services/catalog.inventory-management.catalog-inventory/0.0.1.mdx) - Owns scarce stock reservation, stock release, and inventory position management- [Fulfillment Shipping - fulfillment.shipping.fulfillment-shipping - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/services/fulfillment.shipping.fulfillment-shipping/0.0.1.mdx) - Owns scheduling and readiness of shipping operations after an order is confirmed- [Notifications Consumer - notifications.customer-communications.notifications-consumer - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/services/notifications.customer-communications.notifications-consumer/0.0.1.mdx) - Transforms business outcomes into customer-facing notifications and delivery results- [Orders Checkout - orders.checkout.orders-checkout - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/services/orders.checkout.orders-checkout/0.0.1.mdx) - Owns checkout flow, order lifecycle, and the handoff from purchase intent to confirmed order- [Payments Processing - payments.payment-processing.payments-processing - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/services/payments.payment-processing.payments-processing/0.0.1.mdx) - Owns payment authorization, retries, capture, voiding, and provider-facing outcomes

## Data Products


## Domains
- [Catalog & Inventory - catalog - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/catalog/0.0.1.mdx) - Product catalog, limited editions, inventory and drop management- [Catalog Management - catalog.catalog-management - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/catalog.catalog-management/0.0.1.mdx) - Product catalog definition, publication lifecycle, and release metadata- [Inventory Management - catalog.inventory-management - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/catalog.inventory-management/0.0.1.mdx) - Scarce stock reservation, release handling, and backoffice inventory operations- [Fulfillment - fulfillment - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/fulfillment/0.0.1.mdx) - Operational handling after order confirmation- [Shipping - fulfillment.shipping - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/fulfillment.shipping/0.0.1.mdx) - Shipment scheduling, readiness, and fulfillment failure handling- [Notifications - notifications - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/notifications/0.0.1.mdx) - Customer communication driven by domain outcomes- [Customer Communications - notifications.customer-communications - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/notifications.customer-communications/0.0.1.mdx) - Notification delivery triggered by order, stock, and payment events- [Orders - orders - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/orders/0.0.1.mdx) - Commercial order creation, confirmation, and cancellation- [Checkout - orders.checkout - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/orders.checkout/0.0.1.mdx) - Customer checkout, order commitment, and commercial orchestration- [Payments - payments - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/payments/0.0.1.mdx) - Payment authorization, retry, capture, and compensation- [Payment Processing - payments.payment-processing - 0.0.1 ](https://arcadia-editions.github.io/docs/domains/payments.payment-processing/0.0.1.mdx) - Payment provider integration, lifecycle state, and compensation handling
